title: The Diffusion Duality
tldr_zh: 证明 uniform 离散扩散是高斯扩散的 argmax 投影，借此引入课程学习与离散一致性蒸馏，采样加速两个数量级
tldr_en: Shows uniform-state discrete diffusion emerges from Gaussian diffusion via argmax projection, enabling curriculum learning and discrete consistency distillation for 2-orders-of-magnitude faster sampling

key_numbers.number: 3.0 PPL improvement over UDLM on LM1B (33.7 vs 36.7)
2× training speedup claimed (Duo at 510K steps: PPL 35.2 vs UDLM at 1M steps: 36.7)
128× sampling speedup with Greedy-Tail (1024→8 steps), 64× with ancestral (1024→16 steps)
3/7 zero-shot benchmarks where Duo surpasses AR model (PTB, Wikitext, Lambada)
~1 order of magnitude gradient variance reduction from curriculum learning (top-100 highest-variance weights)
Rao-Blackwellized loss contributes ~1.7 PPL, curriculum ~1.3 PPL of total 3.0 PPL improvement
Duo PPL 43.0 at 100K steps vs Plaid 89.9 at 100K steps on LM1B
